<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **30** documentable anchor(s).

**17** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1013ef11617b578c6525e50300f74f2e0b072b3c`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **170** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1013ef11617b578c6525e50300f74f2e0b072b3c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `39cf8e9e9420870b402c0cc6127db6f6336693ac` — the merge of head `fa3694dfa37337f8d125d75bcdde5a9d4c7bbcdd` into base `1013ef11617b578c6525e50300f74f2e0b072b3c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 39cf8e9e9420870b402c0cc6127db6f6336693ac && git checkout 39cf8e9e9420870b402c0cc6127db6f6336693ac
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1013ef11617b578c6525e50300f74f2e0b072b3c fa3694dfa37337f8d125d75bcdde5a9d4c7bbcdd && git checkout -B drift-repro 1013ef11617b578c6525e50300f74f2e0b072b3c && git merge --no-ff fa3694dfa37337f8d125d75bcdde5a9d4c7bbcdd

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1013ef11617b578c6525e50300f74f2e0b072b3c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 1013ef11617b578c6525e50300f74f2e0b072b3c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读（席位终稿）

- **改了什么**：中文控制台下，Studio 视图属性面板展开「表格选项 / 分页 / 终端用户控制 / 导航与共享」后，里面的各行名称和说明都显示中文（实测英文行从 70 行降到 9 行）。日文、西班牙文目录也一并补齐。
- **为什么改**：#30039 核验时发现，展开这些区块会冒出大量英文，根因是 spec 的视图表单没有声明这些子字段，翻译目录无从覆盖（#30267）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只增加表单声明、提示文字和翻译，英文界面文字不变；面板不再显示两个已退役的键，已存的值保存时原样保留。不改接口和数据。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts` 新声明的子字段，`metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` 的中文行。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的**：无。不是受管面，席位直接落地。
- **席位意见**：ACCEPT。剩下 9 行是「允许的可视化」选项名，目录没有承载选项名的通道，另立卡。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · head `f5483a169f` · 2026-11-05T07:25Z

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #30267`. One changeset: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`. 13 files, +1024/−74 (four generated catalogs ~580 of it). `check-governed-merges --pr 30356`: NOT governed. `git merge-tree` vs `main` `8c9f48f8` clean.
2. **Read by the seat:** route (a) of the Step 1 seam report: `view.form.ts` declares the seven composites' children with labels/hints equal to the current English screen text; the extractor emits `metadataForms.view.fields['<parent>.<child>']`; catalogs regenerated via `check-i18n-bundles --write`; zh rows in the platform bundle, copied by the console overlay. `UserFilterFieldSchema` gains six `.meta({ title })` (English column heads, unchanged on screen). Retired `navigation.view` / `sharing.type` are no longer offered; the seat's condition is met: a stored value survives a panel save (the composite editor spreads the block). Shot `30267-after-zh-CN-panel.png` reads Chinese through all four sections.
3. **Accepted deviations:** file surface beyond the Claim: `view.zod.ts` (six `.meta` titles), `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (three omit rows), `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` (ledger 701 → 731), and the ja-JP / es-ES catalogs (translated, not left as en fills). Claim surface amended here.
4. **Evidence:** spec + ui pins green; `dispatch-gates` 84/84 exit 0 with `--ran` zero NOT-MEASURED. Live zh-CN probe on the example CRM: English rows 70 → 9. CI on this head running at review time; auto-merge waits on it.
5. **Out of scope:** the nine `allowedVisualizations` option chips (Grid / Kanban / …) stay English: the metadata-forms catalog has no channel for a field's option labels; filed separately. Serial with draft PR #30321 on the same four catalogs: whichever lands second merges `main` and regenerates. `Skills-docs:` n/a.
6. **Landing:** ordinary queue, now: relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, follow to MERGED, landing record on #30267.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fa3694dfa37337f8d125d75bcdde5a9d4c7bbcdd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/view-form-composite-children.test.ts, packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts, packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts (translateFormField, resolveMetadataFormSchemaTitles), packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts (walkFormField), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx (CompositeField, RepeaterField, resolveFieldFace, inferWidget), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/view-schema.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts, .changeset/30267-view-panel-zh-composite-rows.md

Inputs read: card #30267 (body, triage 6650062714, claim 6650537881, os-dev-report 6652270137), PR #30356 body and 13-file list, the net diff `origin/main...fa3694dfa` (+1024 / -74), the head's check-runs. The dispatching seat's own notes were not input.

Check-runs on the head as read at the time of this record: `Lint & Repo Gates` success (so `check:generated`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-no-major` are green), `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, `Check Changeset` success, `Spec property liveness` success, `Live E2E UI` success, `Build UI Deps` success, `Type Check · debt ledger` success, `Type Check · source gates` success, `PR-body guards` success, `Flag docs affected` success. Still `in_progress`: `Build Core`, `Test Core` (1-8/8), `Test UI` (1-16/16), `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Build & E2E UI`. The pins this record relies on (`view-form-composite-children.test.ts`, the repeater-title guard, the reconciliation ledger, `view-composite-children.test.ts`, the ui i18n group) are answered by `Test Core` / `Test UI`, which have not concluded; this verdict is on the tree, and the landing waits for those contexts to read `success`.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept-set: unchanged — right.** No authorable key, value or metadata type is added, removed or narrowed. `view.zod.ts` adds `.meta({ title })` to the six properties of `UserFilterFieldSchema` (`view.zod.ts` L2017-2051); a `title` is JSON-Schema presentation, not an accept-set change, and matches the standing pattern on `ViewTabSchema` and `ListColumnSchema`. `.meta()` clones in zod 4, so `I18nLabelSchema.optional().describe().meta()` does not mutate the shared `I18nLabelSchema` (same spelling as `ViewTabSchema.label`).
2. **Public surface: no export change — right.** `viewForm` is an existing export whose runtime value changes shape; its declared type is `FormViewParsed` (`defineForm`, `view.zod.ts` L7991) and is unchanged, and the api-surface snapshot records existence, not value. No committed generated artifact carries schema titles (a tree-wide grep for an existing title, `Primary Link`, hits only the two sources and the en catalog), so nothing under `authorable-surface/`, `json-schema.manifest/` or `api-surface/` went stale; `Lint & Repo Gates` is green on the head and agrees.
3. **The panel stops offering `navigation.view` and `sharing.type` — right, and not a capability removal.** Both are `retiredKey()` tombstones (`view.zod.ts` L2961 and L1875); the schema-derived child list rendered them as editable rows, which is the false-compliant UI half the form already removed for `addRecord.mode` / `formView` (#24692). A stored value is carried through a panel save untouched: `CompositeField` writes `{ ...obj, [spec.field]: v }` (`SchemaForm.tsx` L2730), and the parse already refused the key before this PR.
4. **New translation keys are derived, not hand-listed — right.** `walkFormField` (`i18n-extract.ts` L2512-2528) recurses `field.fields` with dot-path accumulation and humanizes a missing label, so every declared child becomes `metadataForms.view.fields['parent.child']` (and the `userFilters.fields.ROW` keys three deep); the en catalog diff matches that derivation row for row, `navigation.mode` with a label and no hint.
5. **`userFilters` declares exactly the object-view arm's live keys — right.** Studio renders `ViewSchema.properties.list` (`view-schema.ts` `getListVariantSchema`), which is `ObjectListViewSchema` (`view.zod.ts` L5700-5705) whose `userFilters` is `ObjectUserFiltersSchema` = `{ element, fields }` (L5623-5652). The `element` hint copied is that arm's description, byte for byte. The reconciliation walk resolves the `view` union across arms and so sees the page-shaped `tabs` / `showAllRecords` / `allowAddTab`; the three ledger rows are the right instrument (zod-only direction is ledgerable with a reason), and the reason given is true of the tree.
6. **Row component changes from the auto-inferred `master-detail` widget to `RepeaterField`'s grid — right, and the reason the titles alone would not have done.** Before: a composite with no declared children got `derivePropertyNames(schema)` and the array-of-object child fell to `inferWidget` → `'master-detail'` (`SchemaForm.tsx` L517), a per-cell table whose heads are `items.properties[k].title ?? humanizeKey(k)`; the console does not run `resolveMetadataFormSchemaTitles` on this bundled form, so those heads could only ever be English. After: `type: 'repeater'` short-circuits `resolveFieldFace` (L839) before any widget lookup, `widget: 'grid'` selects the table layout (`RepeaterField` `useGrid`), and the heads are the declared labels (`s.label || prettify(s.field)`), which the overlay translates. `required: true` on `field` mirrors `field: z.string()` (required in the item schema) and renders as the header marker plus cell `aria-required`. `'grid'` is a free `widget` string on `FormFieldSchema` with no spec registry to register in; the ui's own grid-naming tests already exercise `widget: 'grid'` on repeaters.
7. **The server path serves the same rows — right.** `translateFormField` (`i18n-resolver.ts` L5491-5538) prefers a declared `fields` array and recurses with the same dot paths; synthesis from bundle children runs only when none is declared. So `/meta/types` serves the seven composites with their declared children and the platform zh-CN leaves, the same rows the console overlay gives.
8. **Serial constraint with #30321 — cleared.** Its merge commit `c7d1367a` is an ancestor of this head (merged 10:04Z, head is a merge of `origin/main`), and `check:i18n` inside the green `Lint & Repo Gates` reads the four catalogs in sync.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/30267-view-panel-zh-composite-rows.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch — the three packages the diff moves, each named. Body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, line-initial, matching the PR body's two lines. Judgment: **correct**. Nothing an author can write changed (a form layout, hint text, catalog rows and a presentation `title` are not protocol; the two tombstones were already refused), so `none` and `patch` are the level the rule gives; no narrowing arm, so no BREAKING banner or ADR-0087 marker is owed. `Check Changeset` success; the changeset gates inside `Lint & Repo Gates` success.
Clause-②: no

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared — nothing to answer.
- Out-of-scope (a), `appearance.allowedVisualizations` option chips still English (9 rows left live): correctly left out — the extractor emits `label` / `helpText` / `placeholder` only (`i18n-extract.ts` L2520-2522) and no catalog channel exists for a form field's option labels, so fixing it here would be a new channel, not this card. It is a reproducible defect with a named location, so under Prime Directive #10 it is a card, not a note: **escalated to the seat to file** (the report records it with dedupe words; no issue number is cited in the tree).
- Out-of-scope (seat note), the read-only package's table offering an add control: observation only, no write reproduced; stays a note.
- "File surface beyond the claim" (`view.zod.ts` six titles, two ledger tests, ja-JP / es-ES catalogs): all within the dispatch's stop conditions — no governed path hit (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success, file list has none), `Metadata-protocol: none` holds (①.1), and the catalogs are regenerated output the echo ledgers require, not hand-edited.
- Dispatch's Step 1 seam reading (does the extractor already walk declared children?) was measured and reported (reading a); the tree agrees (①.4).
- PR body says the catalogs' "provenance companions lose rows"; no such file is in the file list or the tree (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` holds the four catalogs and tests only). Body inaccuracy, no tree effect; not reviewed.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`** — against `view.zod.ts` on this head and the zh-CN Studio panel it is accepted against.

- Each declared child list equals the schema's live keys, checked by hand against the head: `selection` {type}; `pagination` {pageSize, pageSizeOptions}; `userFilters` {element, fields} on the object arm (①.5); `appearance` {showDescription, allowedVisualizations}; `userActions` all eleven (sort, search, filter, refresh, rowHeight, group, addRecordForm, editInline, hideFields, rowColor, buttons); `addRecord` {enabled, position}; `navigation` {mode, preventNavigation, openNewTab, size, width}; `sharing` {lockedBy}. Every declared hint is the property's `.describe()` text byte for byte (the long `pageSize`, `editInline` and `hideFields` strings included); `navigation.mode` declares none because `NavigationModeSchema` is a bare `enumWithRetiredValues` with no `.describe()` and the property adds none (`view.zod.ts` L2904-2909, L2957), so an English console reads what it read before. The top-level rows that gained a hint copy the `ListViewShapeSchema` descriptions (`resizable` L3468, `compactToolbar` L3469, `rowHeight` L3526, `selection` L3472, `pagination` L3478, `addRecord` L3677, `showRecordCount` L3680, `navigation` L3475, `sharing` L3509 — the colon form, not `ViewSharingSchema`'s own dash form).
- The cost of declaring (a key added to a block tomorrow silently leaving the panel) is paid: `view-form-composite-children.test.ts` holds each list equal to the live keys and each hint equal to the description, deriving the schema the way `view-schema.ts` does (`z.toJSONSchema(ViewSchema, { io: 'input' }).properties.list`); the repeater guard now derives `view:userFilters.fields` as a carrier with all six row properties titled and its LEDGER still empty; the reconciliation walk gets three reasoned `omit` rows instead of a silent pass.
- Break attempts: a stored `navigation.view` survives a panel save (①.3); a page-shaped `userFilters` cannot reach this form (the form is laid out for the object arm, and the page list has its own inspector); the `options` column inside the grid is an array of objects and renders as a nested `object-rows` repeater in a cell — the same shape the `master-detail` cell had, so no new hole; the catalog overlay in `metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` names every child of every declared composite (checked row by row), so the all-or-none composite rule cannot bite.
- The header comment cites the card number in a code comment, which this repo's code comments do throughout (`[#24692]`, `[#20301]`); `check:issue-citations` is inside the green `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- **should-fix (low; pre-existing wording the PR leaves beside a child that now contradicts it):** the `userFilters` composite's own hint still reads "element style (dropdown / tabs / toggle) + exposed fields or tab presets" while its new `element` child says `"tabs" is page-only — use listViews`, and the object arm refuses `tabs` (`ObjectUserFiltersSchema`, L5623). The zh-CN overlay copies the same sentence. One row's text; a follow-up edit, not a blocker.
- Boundary, not a finding: the type-specific composites (`kanban`, `calendar`, `gantt`, `gallery`, `timeline`, `chart`) stay bare and so stay on the schema-derived, untranslatable path; the card names the four shared sections only.

**`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`** — against the repeater-title guard (`kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts`) and its first consumer, the grid head.

- The six titles are exactly what the `master-detail` table printed from `humanizeKey` (`Field`, `Label`, `Type`, `Options`, `Show Count`, `Default Values`), so the English column heads are unchanged; `view.form.ts` repeats them as row `label`s, and the composite-children test holds the two equal, so they cannot drift. The guard requires every row property of an enumerated repeater to carry a title, and the schema now does; no LEDGER entry was added.
- The doc comment states the mechanism correctly (the title is the English head; the form's label repeats it so the extractor emits a key per column) — the same note `columns` carries.
- Break attempts: the titles ride both `io: 'input'` and `'output'` derivations identically; `UserFilterFieldSchema` is also the item schema under the page-shaped `UserFiltersSchema`, where the titles are harmless. No committed artifact reads them (①.2). Nothing found.

**must-fix:** none.

Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzfE4V9fzZgJLrLDmMC`

**VERDICT: PASS**
